title: Cheddar Bay Chicken Bake
cookTime: Baked, then broiled ~3 minutes at the end to brown the top
ingredients: Cream of chicken soup (some commenters swap for cheddar cheese soup or roasted chicken gravy)
Seasoning packet (type not specified in video)
Cheddar Bay biscuit mix topping (or premade frozen Cheddar Bay biscuits, per commenters)
instructions: Mix chicken with cream of chicken soup, cream cheese, sour cream, and seasoning packet in a baking dish.
Top with cheddar bay biscuit mixture (or lay premade cheddar bay biscuits on top, per commenter Shelby Warden).
Bake until the biscuit topping is cooked through and golden.
Broil for about 3 minutes at the end to brown the top (per commenter Diane Urban's question in comments).
